verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of daily settlement files, a reporting API, or reconciliation data covering interchange, fees, or network adjustments. The transactions retrieval endpoint and event webhooks are related but different features. They are not reconciliation artifacts, so they earn no credit. The axis clearly applies to a card-issuing platform, so this is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a finance lead, I get machine-readable reconciliation artifacts — daily settlement files or report APIs covering interchange, fees, and network adjustments — that my finance stack can consume automatically
